name_vi: Túi mây khung miệng bác sĩ
description_en: A rigid rectangular woven body with hinged metal mouth frame, two short cane handles and leather corner guards. Canonical front: a central unmarked metal clasp above the woven wall. Side view: a deep triangular gusset beneath the open-mouth hinge. Rear view: an uninterrupted woven wall with two handle anchors. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A rigid rectangular woven body with hinged metal mouth frame, two short cane handles and leather corner guards. Canonical front: a central unmarked metal clasp above the woven wall. Side view: a deep triangular gusset beneath the open-mouth hinge. Rear view: an uninterrupted woven wall with two handle anchors. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Modern: clean contemporary geometry. Relative size compact within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: close herringbone V-shaped twill. Finish: deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
